headline: Satya Nadella issues a warning to companies using AI, while Apple sues OpenAI over alleged trade secret theft
tldr: Today's AI news is dominated by warnings and lawsuits, with Satya Nadella cautioning companies about the potential risks of AI and Apple suing OpenAI over alleged trade secret theft. Meanwhile, Anthropic is localizing its Claude pricing for India, and Waze is adding new AI-powered features. Researchers are also exploring new AI discoveries and warning about potential security threats.
